description: Closure computations for the two-edge path on three points.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.RelationExtensions.three_point_closures :
  have R := fun a b => a = 0 ∧ b = 1 ∨ a = 1 ∧ b = 2;
  (∀ (a b : Fin 3), Relation.TransGen R a b ↔ a < b) ∧
    (∀ (a b : Fin 3), Relation.ReflTransGen R a b ↔ a ≤ b) ∧ ∀ (a b : Fin 3), Relation.EqvGen R a b
